description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Phantasmal Image
uses.cardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead
